result.rationale: VIIA is the single 2020 Vopak-BlackRock joint-venture platform that acquired three Dow Gulf Coast terminals. The regulator identifies BlackRock Alternatives Management, LLC for GEPIF III. BlackRock's 2024 GIP acquisition was a manager-level combination, not evidence of a VIIA stake transfer or separate GIP ownership period. No public exit or pending sale was found through the as-of date.
